text_en: Now the whole earth had one language and the same words.
text_cn: 当时全世界只有一种语言和一样的话。

text_en: And as they migrated from the east, they came upon a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
text_cn: 当人们由东方迁移的时候，在史纳尔地方找到了一块平原，就在那里住下了。

text_en: And they said to one another, “Come, let us make bricks, and burn them thoroughly. ” And they had brick for stone, and bitumen for mortar.
text_cn: 他们彼此说：“来，我们做砖，用火烧透。”他们遂拿砖当石，拿沥青代灰泥。

text_en: Then they said, “Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower with its top in the heavens, and let us make a name for ourselves; otherwise we shall be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth. ”
text_cn: 然后彼此说：“来，让我们建造一城一塔，塔顶摩天，好给我们作记念，免得我们在全地面上分散了！”

text_en: The Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which mortals had built.
text_cn: 上主遂下来，要看看世人所造的城和塔。

text_en: And the Lord said, “Look, they are one people, and they have all one language; and this is only the beginning of what they will do; nothing that they propose to do will now be impossible for them.
text_cn: 上主说：“看，他们都是一个民族，都说一样的语言。他们如今就开始做这事；以后他们所想做的，就没有不成功的了。

text_en: Come, let us go down, and confuse their language there, so that they will not understand one another’s speech. ”
text_cn: 来，我们下去，混乱他们的语言，使他们彼此语言不通。”

text_en: So the Lord scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth, and they left off building the city.
text_cn: 于是上主将他们分散到全地面，他们遂停止建造那城。

text_en: Therefore it was called Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of all the earth; and from there the Lord scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth.
text_cn: 为此人称那地为“巴贝耳”，因为上主在那里混乱了全地的语言，且从那里将他们分散到全地面。

text_en: These are the descendants of Shem. When Shem was one hundred years old, he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood;
text_cn: 以下是闪的后裔：洪水后两年，闪正一百岁，生了阿帕革沙得；

text_en: and Shem lived after the birth of Arpachshad five hundred years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生阿帕革沙得后，闪还活了五百年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Arpachshad had lived thirty-five years, he became the father of Shelah;
text_cn: 阿帕革沙得三十五岁时，生了舍拉；

text_en: and Arpachshad lived after the birth of Shelah four hundred three years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生舍拉后，阿帕革沙得还活了四百零三年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Shelah had lived thirty years, he became the father of Eber;
text_cn: 舍拉三十岁时，生了厄贝尔；

text_en: and Shelah lived after the birth of Eber four hundred three years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生厄贝尔后，舍拉还活了四百零三年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Eber had lived thirty-four years, he became the father of Peleg;
text_cn: 厄贝尔三十四岁时，生了培肋格；

text_en: and Eber lived after the birth of Peleg four hundred thirty years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生培肋格后，厄贝尔还活了四百三十年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Peleg had lived thirty years, he became the father of Reu;
text_cn: 培肋格三十岁时，生了勒伍；

text_en: and Peleg lived after the birth of Reu two hundred nine years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生勒伍后，培肋格还活了二百零九年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Reu had lived thirty-two years, he became the father of Serug;
text_cn: 勒伍三十二岁时，生了色鲁格；

text_en: and Reu lived after the birth of Serug two hundred seven years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生色鲁格后，勒伍还活了二百零七年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Serug had lived thirty years, he became the father of Nahor;
text_cn: 色鲁格三十岁时，生了纳曷尔；

text_en: and Serug lived after the birth of Nahor two hundred years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生纳曷尔后，色鲁格还活了二百年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Nahor had lived twenty-nine years, he became the father of Terah;
text_cn: 纳曷尔活到二十九岁时，生了特辣黑；

text_en: and Nahor lived after the birth of Terah one hundred nineteen years, and had other sons and daughters.
text_cn: 生特辣黑后，纳曷尔还活了一百一十九年，也生了其他的儿女。

text_en: When Terah had lived seventy years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
text_cn: 特辣黑七十岁时，生了亚巴郎、纳曷尔和哈郎。

text_en: Now these are the descendants of Terah. Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.
text_cn: 以下是特辣黑的后裔：特辣黑生了亚巴郎、纳曷尔和哈郎；哈郎生了罗特。

text_en: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
text_cn: 哈郎在他的出生地，加色丁人的乌尔，死在他父亲特辣黑面前。

text_en: Abram and Nahor took wives; the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah. She was the daughter of Haran the father of Milcah and Iscah.
text_cn: 亚巴郎和纳曷尔都娶了妻子：亚巴郎的妻子名叫撒辣依；纳曷尔的妻子名叫米耳加，她是哈郎的女儿；哈郎是米耳加和依色加的父亲。

text_en: Now Sarai was barren; she had no child.
text_cn: 撒辣依不生育，没有子女。

text_en: Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram’s wife, and they went out together from Ur of the Chaldeans to go into the land of Canaan; but when they came to Haran, they settled there.
text_cn: 特辣黑带了自己的儿子亚巴郎和孙子，即哈郎的儿子罗特，并儿媳，即亚巴郎的妻子撒辣依，一同由加色丁的乌尔出发，往客纳罕地去；他们到了哈兰，就在那里住下了。

text_en: The days of Terah were two hundred five years; and Terah died in Haran.
text_cn: 特辣黑死于哈兰，享寿二百零五岁。
